BSF HCM & ASI Steno Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Border Security Force (BSF) has released the answer key for the Probationary Assistant Sub Inspector ASI Stenographer and Head Constable HC Ministerial Post. This recruitment was released for 1526 posts. Applications for BSF HC Ministerial and ASI Steno Recruitment 2024 were filled from 09 June 2024 to 08 July 2024. The written examination was held on 01 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their BSF HCM & ASI Steno Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

  • Application Start Date : 09 June 2024
  • Last Date : 08 July 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 July 2024
  • Exam Date : March 2025
  • Admit Card : 05 March 2025
  • Result : 01 September 2025
  • Written Exam Date : 01 September 2026
  • Written Exam Admit Card : 19 August 2026
  • Answer Key Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
